query: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.specialties, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.therapyType) as therapy_types_used FROM users u LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.therapistUserId = u.id WHERE u.name LIKE '%Marcely%' GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.specialties;
